    Profile

    Jin is a young man from a warrior family that has lived in Wadatsumi for generations. He is Yomi's half-brother, and the elder of the two. When it was time for the head of the family to change, the family argued over whether direct descendent Yomi or mistress's son Jin should take over, which culminated in Jin killing his father and the rest of the family. Deep down he is a gentle soul, like his birth mother, but his harsh, rigorous training has steeled him and turned his heart cold.

    Origin: Wadatsumi
    Gender: Male
    Height: 180cm
    Weight: 69kg
    Birthday: Dec 3
    Blood Type: Type Ki
    Zodiac: Moon of the Nightmare Cherry Blossom
    Likes: Family, pickled plums
    Hobbies: Spotting shooting stars
    Illust: だーくろ
    CV: 保志総一朗
